# Requirements Quality Checklist

## Requirement ID Coverage

- [x] All requirements use `REQ-XXX` format.
- [x] IDs are unique and sequential.

## Testability

- [x] Every requirement is independently testable.
- [x] Acceptance scenarios use concrete Given-When-Then outcomes.
- [x] Success criteria are measurable and technology-agnostic.

## Completeness

- [x] Scope baseline is complete.
- [x] User scenarios are prioritized.
- [x] Functional requirements cover evidence, questionnaires, ordered target assessment, discovery, review, portfolios, governance, and reporting.
- [x] Key entities and assumptions are defined.
- [x] Existing manual graph and portfolio information is protected during transition.

## Clarification Status

- [x] Primary target is Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server.
- [x] Secondary target is Azure SQL Managed Instance with SQL Server on Azure Virtual Machines as fallback.
- [x] Final target is Oracle Database@Azure with Oracle Database on Azure Virtual Machines as fallback.
- [x] Discovered dependencies require candidate review before becoming authoritative.
- [x] Questionnaire responses are accepted as attributed evidence.
- [x] No unresolved clarification markers remain.

## Planning Readiness

- [x] Requirements are ready for architecture design and implementation planning.
- [ ] Project constitution is available.
- [ ] Feature-specific data model and API/service contracts are available.
- [ ] Project topology or explicit module grouping is available.
